Most weapons have a +1 chance to hit at half range.
TACOMs can spot from inside a carrier.
Small arms can still be fired while inside a carrier.
Units are still able to spot as normal while embarked, desanted, or towed.
To decide which arc is targeted while firing on a target, use center to center measurement and use the first arc it passes through.
Blind firing can still score kills, even if it requires luck. At minimum, it adds pin.
For LOS, you can draw a line from any point on the edge of one unit to any point on the edge of another.
Infinite blinds can embark/desant into vehicles and do not count towards that carrier's capacity.
You can edit the Mass Rename list by editing NameLists.json in Resources.
Some units have keywords that don't exist in the standard game. Their keywords reflect special rules which Firelock Companion may need to be warned about.
The first strength value for Shaped Charge ammo is the strength against armored targets, while the second is against infantry. There's more complexity, too. Check the keyword.
Rygo forces are estimated to only be ~160,000, including only 5,000 aircraft. Whenever you kill one, you're putting a measurable dent in their force numbers.
The earlier you throw you gunpowder into the great gun, the luckier you will be in the next year.
Time-to-target is usually reduced by 1 at half range. This applies to guided and heavy indirect weapons.
Vehicles do not lose movement from pin.
Blinds can be paradropped. Especially helpful if that blind is pretending to be a ganglion.
Paradropped vehicles cannot hold desanting infantry during the deployment phase.
Units in ambush can still be spotted by any unit with 6".
Infantry can be in ambush using non-front arcs.
Buildings have a capacity of 3 infantry units. In this case, both infantry and squads count as a single unit.
When brigade moving infantry, all units must end the move while still in bridage range.
Different factions have different preferred units. You probably don't need the same amount of anti-air if you're fighting feds instead of santagrians.
Artillery units can remove counterbattery tokens by moving.
Homing type attacks can still roll to hit aircraft that have left the board.
If an attack and a smoke resolve at the same time, the attack does not suffer the smoke penalty.
Per the rules, you are not allowed to play the Federals without first downing an entire bottle of your alcohol of choice.
It's okay to bring units with intent for them to die. It's not like you're the one writing letter back to their families.
Smoke generally favors units with thermal sights or sense.
Any weapon with the Nuclear keyword cannot be reloaded.
